description: Azarketis, inheritors of a shattered empire's legacy, hold their proud traditions close but still surface to interact with the rest of the world.

features.name: Hydrated Breath
features.tldr: You require regular immersion in water to stay healthy, but thrive seamlessly in aquatic environments.

features.name: Ancestry Heritage
features.tldr: Choose an azarketi heritage reflecting your lineage from specific aquatic domains.
